title: Queen Victoria Passenger Information — V1
updated: 2026-11-09 — refurbishment details available from the dedicated menu

sections.heading: Welcome aboard Queen Victoria
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D guide, not affiliated with Cunard. Queen Victoria is known for elegant public rooms, dining and entertainment. Confirm current facilities with Cunard.

sections.heading: Official ship and deck plans
sections.body:
Official Cunard Queen Victoria ship information and interactive deck plans (internet required): https://www.cunard.com/en-gb/cruise-ships/queen-victoria
Select a deck on the official website for current venue locations.

sections.heading: Deck reference
sections.body: Use Cunard’s current Queen Victoria deck plan to locate staterooms, lifts, accessible routes and venues. Locations may change.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Queen Victoria offers Britannia Restaurant, Britannia Club, Princess Grill, Queens Grill, Lido Restaurant, Steakhouse at The Verandah and Golden Lion. Main dining depends on your stateroom category. Check reservations and charges.

sections.heading: Bars and lounges
sections.body: Queen Victoria has Commodore Club, Chart Room, Golden Lion, Winter Garden, Yacht Club and Midships Bar, among others. Check hours onboard.

sections.heading: Entertainment
sections.body: Queen Victoria offers Royal Court Theatre shows, Queens Room events, live music, Yacht Club dancing and guest activities. Programmes vary by sailing.

sections.heading: Wellness and outdoor spaces
sections.body: Mareel Wellness & Beauty, fitness facilities, Lido Pool, Pavilion Pool and outdoor sports areas. Cunard announced a Pavilion Wellness Café for November 2026; confirm availability onboard.

sections.heading: 2026 refurbishment
sections.body: Cunard announced a Queen Victoria refit from 17 October to 5 November 2026, including refreshed Queens Room, Grand Lobby and Grill facilities. Consult Cunard for completed details.

sections.heading: Before travelling
sections.body: Check passport, visa and entry requirements, insurance, luggage labels, boarding instructions and Cunard’s current advice.

sections.heading: First day onboard
sections.body: Find your cabin, review muster arrangements and check dining details and the daily programme.

sections.heading: Ports and excursions
sections.body: Record meeting points, excursions and all-aboard times. Follow the ship’s official schedule.

sections.heading: Offline and privacy
sections.body: Personal notes are stored on your device. External official links require internet access. This independent app does not connect to Cunard onboard systems.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Unofficial independent passenger companion, not endorsed by or affiliated with Cunard. Confirm prices, opening hours and deck details with Cunard.
